Project Scope & Charter Baseline
Problem Statement & 6-Stage Admission Lifecycle
Slide 2 / 10
The Problem & Operational Challenges
Legacy Inefficiencies: Manual paper forms and unvalidated portals cause application loss and processing delays.
Network Fragility: Institutional campus networks frequently drop cloud database connections during peak admission rush.
Upload Risks: Corrupt non-PDF documents and oversized files crash application handlers and consume disk storage.
Core Mission: Deliver a self-contained, dual-engine admissions system with zero downtime and immutable data governance.
Project Charter Constraints & Governance
Timeline: Strict 20-day delivery lifecycle from charter sign-off to full production deployment.
Target Platform: Windows 11 Desktop running Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge (1366×768+).
Technology Stack: Next.js / Vanilla JS Frontend, FastAPI ASGI backend, and Dual DB layer.
Operating Policy: Autonomous separation of duties across Frontend, Backend, Database, and Testing teams.
6-Stage End-to-End Admission Workflow
1. Registration & Auth: Salted password hashing via PBKDF2; @gmail.com email domain enforcement.
2. 4-Step Form Wizard: Student inputs personal details, academic scores (Class 10/12), and course selection.
3. PDF Marksheet Upload: Strict MIME header verification and 5MB size limit before saving.
4. Immutable Lock: Timestamped final submit locks all form fields against subsequent modification.
5. Admin Triage: Admission officers filter applications, inspect documents, and update status with remarks.
6. Live Tracking: Real-time student tracking timeline displaying decision progress (Under Review, Accepted, Rejected).

High-Level Design (HLD)
System Architecture & Dual-Engine Persistence
Slide 4 / 10
Presentation & Application Tiers
Presentation Tier: Responsive SPA rendered on Chrome/Edge (Windows 11) using modern asynchronous fetch requests over TLS.
FastAPI ASGI Service: High-performance async microservice with Pydantic validation schemas, RBAC auth middleware, and CORS security.
Intelligent Dual-Engine DB Abstraction
Unified Abstraction: database.py encapsulates both MongoDB Atlas (Cloud NoSQL) and SQLite3 (Embedded ACID engine).
Auto DNS Resolution: Injects Google (8.8.8.8) and Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) nameservers to resolve Windows SRV query failures.
Zero-Downtime Failover: If MongoDB Atlas ping exceeds 4000ms, seamlessly defaults to SQLite (iem_admission.db) without service disruption.
Decoupled Document Storage
MIME & Size Validator: Multipart parser checks PDF magic headers and rejects files over 5MB.
Hybrid Storage: Writes files to local /uploads or serverless /tmp, storing lightweight URI references in the active database.

System Data Flow & Data Stores
Data Flow Architecture & Subsystem Interaction (DFD)
Slide 5 / 10
1.0 - 3.0 Core Admission Pipeline
1.0 Manage Auth: Verifies credentials, hashes passwords, reads/writes D1, and issues signed JWT tokens.
2.0 Manage Details: Validates personal details, Class 10/12 marks, and course selection; updates draft application in D1.
3.0 Process Upload: Validates PDF stream, writes binary to D2 Document Storage, and links URI in D1.
4.0 - 5.0 Submission & Triage
4.0 Manage Submission: Freezes draft, stamps submission timestamp, and irreversibly sets status to 'Submitted'.
5.0 Status Management: Enables admin to search/filter candidates, inspect marksheets from D2, and update status with audit logs.
Executive Analytics: Director queries aggregated metrics and generates filtered CSV reports directly from 5.0.
Data Stores D1 & D2 Specifications
D1: Student/Application Data: Persists user credentials, applicant profiles, academic percentages, application statuses, and audit logs.
D2: Document Storage: Physical filesystem (/uploads) storing PDF marksheets with sanitized unique identifiers.
Referential Integrity: D1 holds relative URI path references to D2 file objects.

Finite State Machine & Validation Engine
Admission Lifecycle State Machine & Business Rules
Slide 6 / 10
BR-01 & BR-02: Form Immutability
BR-01 Password Policy: Passwords must be >=8 characters, contain >=1 uppercase letter, and >=1 special character.
BR-02 Application Edit Lock: Once an applicant submits, personal details, academic scores, and documents are locked permanently.
Server-Side Guard: Any post-submission mutation attempts trigger HTTP 403 Forbidden.
BR-03: Legal State Transitions
Valid Workflow: Draft -> Submitted -> Under Review -> Accepted / Rejected.
Direct Rejection Guard: Applications in 'Submitted' state may be rejected directly ONLY if explanatory remarks are provided.
Terminal States: 'Accepted' and 'Rejected' are terminal; no further status reversals are permitted.
BR-04 & Audit Trail Logging
BR-04 Academic Score Bounds: Class 10 and 12 percentages must fall strictly between 0.0% and 100.0%.
Audit Trail Logging: Every state change records timestamp, actor email, previous state, new state, and remarks.
Compliance: Guarantees transparency and audit-readiness for university accreditation.

Software Verification & Test Strategy
Testing Strategy, Basis Path Analysis & Quality Metrics
Slide 8 / 10
White-Box Testing: McCabe's Basis Path Analysis
Target Logic Module: validate_status_transition(current, new, remarks) in backend/workflow.py.
Control Flow Graph (CFG): Nodes (N) = 20, Edges (E) = 27, Decision Predicates (P) = 9.
Cyclomatic Complexity: V(G) = E - N + 2P = 27 - 20 + 2(1) = 9 (or P + 1 = 10 independent paths).
100% Path Coverage: Codified all 10 linearly independent basis paths into automated unit test fixtures.
Black-Box Test Design (BVA & ECP)
Equivalence Partitioning: Password complexity (min 8 chars, uppercase, special char) and phone format partitions.
Boundary Value Analysis: Percentage inputs tested at 0.0%, 100.0%, -0.1%, and 100.1%.
PDF File Size Thresholds: Tested 4.99MB (accepted), 5.00MB (accepted boundary), and 5.01MB (rejected).
Automated Test Suite (backend/test_suite.py)
Test Execution Status: 16 out of 16 Automated Test Fixtures Passing (100% Pass Rate).
Multi-Database Parity: Executed identically against both SQLite3 and live MongoDB Atlas without regressions.
Sandwich Integration: Lightweight synthetic JWT tokens and mock PDF byte buffers used as stubs and drivers.
Zero Defect Escape: Automated regression suite executed on every code commit.

Cloud Architecture & Edge Routing
Cloud Deployment, Serverless Edge & Live Demonstration
Slide 9 / 10
Live Production Deployment
Production URL: iem-admission-system-nexus-p4.vercel.app
Global Edge Network: Fast static asset delivery with automatic SSL/TLS 1.3 termination.
Serverless ASGI Gateway: api/index.py bridges Vercel serverless functions directly into FastAPI.
Hybrid Execution & Portability
Dual Environment Parity: Operates identically locally via python run_server.py and on Vercel Edge Serverless.
Zero Code Mutation: Dynamic environment inspection detects host runtime and adjusts routes automatically.
Ephemeral File Handling: Uses /tmp on serverless instances to process uploads without disk lockups.
Fault Isolation & Resilience
MongoDB Atlas Connectivity: Connects to cloud replica set; auto-injects public DNS to bypass SRV query failures.
Offline Graceful Fallback: If campus network isolates cloud access, system safely stores data in local SQLite database.
Zero Data Loss: Submissions and audit logs remain intact across all failure modes.
